mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 0.3% per month signals stronger employment growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.3% per month over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1000 units per month signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags on corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) above 0.5% per month signals stronger manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings and supports higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0.5% per month over 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) below $350 billion per month signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and prompts tighter monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of very low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% quarter-over-quarter signals weakening economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).
